git.status_scope: Post-run working tree, including unrelated existing changes and documentation written after collection; not a reconstruction of exact launch-time status

limitations: The 1536-row equal-case diagnostic aggregate is not a replay of actual 256-row training minibatches.
Fresh critic is BEFORE the configured 4096-decision warmup; this cannot establish historical postwarmup clipping or a cause of the earlier regression.
Global versus separate clipping compares derivative scaling only, not Adam parameter steps.
Later critics are cross-fitted to fixed parent-policy GAE returns bootstrapped by the fresh critic; these are not later-policy on-policy value targets.
